TRAFFIC ADVISORY
Heavy traffic is reported at Multiple Bridge along the Sagamu–Ore/Benin Expressway due to a broken-down truck restricting movement to one lane. Travellers are advised to use alternative routes via Lagos–Epe–Ijebu-Ode, Ilishan–Ago–Iwoye, Okun Owa–Ijebu-Ode, and Epe–Ijebu-Ode. Motorists already caught in the gridlock are urged to remain patient. Operatives of relevant security and traffic management agencies are on ground to clear the obstruction and restore free flow of traffic as soon as possible. Any inconvenience is regretted.
